def transform(grid):
    R, C = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,)}
    marker = next(c for c in colors if any(c == v for row in grid for v in row))
    # The marker is the sparse color distinct from the two background values.
    counts = {v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) for v in colors}
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    pts = [(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            cells=[(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in shape]
            if all(0<=rr<R and 0<=cc<C and grid[rr][cc]==0 for rr,cc in cells):
                for rr,cc in cells: out[rr][cc]=marker
    return out
